device_environment.source: Read-only session correlation with MCP metadata in the same server log window
device_environment.limit: Device alias, hardware revision and firmware source commit not independently established; no new flash readback or physical playback-clock measurement.

scope: User-triggered physical-device interaction; service-side timings from model invocation to first audio frame send. No external microphone-to-speaker clock.

cases.name: counting_test
cases.association: ASR-result hash matched turn-input hash; user-described counting request matched numeric variants without exporting raw text

restoration.limitation: Persistent state directory and mount preserved; dynamic contents were not snapshotted or compared.

limits: Two measured interactions do not establish a latency distribution.
TTS duration does not distinguish connection, upstream first-byte, and remaining-audio transfer.
Physical wake detection, uplink, ASR, and device playback buffering are outside the monotonic total.
No raw transcript, model answer, audio, identity or credentials are included.
